provenance: Each observation is explicitly classified as PURE_XNA_DERIVED metadata or RUBY_MAPPING_QUALIFICATION; never CNA output
derivation: Foundation 39 member-level dependency edges. Every edge is a call/callvirt/newobj/ldftn/ldvirtftn/jmp operand the IL extractor already collected for the native-reachability fixpoint, kept when it lands on a pinned reference type other than its owner and normalised the same way -- a nested type spelled Parent+Child, a quoted name stripped. The rows below pin the three facts that changed a conclusion: GameComponent's whole body reaches exactly one member of Game, Game::get_Components; DrawableGameComponent's body reaches nine members of IGraphicsDeviceService, which no public signature of that type names, and its Initialize throws InvalidOperationException(MissingGraphicsDeviceService) when the service is absent; and GamerServicesComponent reaches Game::get_Window, which is still one of Game's deferred members.

observations.note: Foundation 39 measured this row as IGraphicsDeviceService with 13 il-only blocked candidates. Foundation 40 built that candidate, so it left the candidate list and the row now names the type the refinement uncovered behind it. This is a RUBY_MAPPING_QUALIFICATION row -- a measurement of this projection's own frontier, which a milestone acting on the frontier is expected to move -- not an XNA fact. Foundation 46 moved it again, from 19 candidates to 18, by projecting Dictionary`2 and consuming LaunchParameters -- the only entry that left. Foundation 48 moved it a third time: building GameWindow took the candidate count from 18 to 17, and because GameWindow was GamerServicesComponent's only il-only unmet dependency, that candidate moved from the il-only blocked list -- 12 to 11 -- into partialDependencySatisfied, which is precisely the transition this row exists to observe. Foundation 49 moved it a fourth time, 17 candidates to 15, by projecting the SerializationInfo/StreamingContext pair and consuming both exception types that named it. Foundation 50 moved it a fifth time, 15 candidates to 14, by projecting Audio.RendererDetail, whose deferral was about its producer rather than the type. Foundation 51 moved it a sixth time, 14 candidates to 13, by projecting Media.VisualizationData, whose deferral was about its filler rather than the type. Foundation 52 moved it a seventh time by projecting Media.Video, whose deferral was about its producer rather than the type: 13 candidates to 12, and because Video was Media.VideoPlayer's last unmet signature dependency, that candidate entered the il-only blocked list, 11 to 12. The System.IO.Stream projection moved it an eighth time, 12 candidates to 11, by consuming TitleContainer -- whose only unmapped BCL identity was Stream, and which was the highest-value entry the register named. Nothing else moved: the il-only blocked list and both partial counts are unchanged, because TitleContainer was no other candidate's unmet dependency. The ContentManager milestone moved it a ninth time, and in four of its six elements at once: the System.IO.Stream and System.Action`1 projections and the generic-method rule consumed ContentManager, so dependencyCompleteCandidates went 11 to 12 -- it left, and ResourceContentManager and GamerServicesComponent appeared behind it, the latter no longer il-only blocked because Game became complete. GamerServicesComponent therefore left the partialDependencySatisfied list, the il-only blocked list fell 12 to 11 and its signature-complete subset 6 to 5, the second of those because the System.Byte[] decision took Microphone's BCL half away as well. The audio cluster moved it a tenth time, in its last two elements only: building Audio.SoundEffect and Audio.SoundEffectInstance took SoundEffectInstance off the il-only blocked list, 11 to 10, and off its signature-complete subset, 5 to 4. dependencyCompleteCandidates is unchanged at 12 because DynamicSoundEffectInstance arrived as SoundEffectInstance left -- completing a type uncovers what derives from it. And an eleventh time, in three elements: Graphics.TextureCollection's deferral turned out to be simply mistaken rather than reasoned from a wrong premise -- the two routes it needs are exported by the retired 0.7.0 artifact as well -- so building it took dependencyCompleteCandidates 12 to 11, the il-only blocked list 10 to 9 and its signature-complete subset 4 to 3. And a twelfth time, again in the last three elements: GamerServices.GamerServicesComponent was blocked on NATIVE_RUNTIME, which is not a blocker -- CNA's dispatcher routes are process-global statics with no handle, exactly as XNA's GamerServicesDispatcher is -- so building it took dependencyCompleteCandidates 11 to 10. It left the candidate list without moving either il-only count, because it had never been on the il-only blocked list -- the member-level refinement had it under partialDependencySatisfied instead, reaching Game::get_Window. A thirteenth time, in one element only: Audio.DynamicSoundEffectInstance was blocked on NATIVE_RUNTIME, which is not a blocker, and building it took dependencyCompleteCandidates 10 to 9. Neither il-only count moved, because it had reached the frontier only when the audio cluster completed its base -- completing a type uncovers what derives from it, and building that in turn removes it again. A fourteenth time, again in one element only: Audio.Microphone was blocked on NATIVE_RUNTIME, which is not a blocker for the sixth time in this register -- this machine reports three capture devices, CNA enumerates every one of them by name, and the retired 0.7.0 headers declare the same sixteen cna_microphone_* routes -- so building it took dependencyCompleteCandidates 9 to 8. Neither il-only count moved, because Microphone had never been il-only blocked: its own signature was complete once the System.Byte[] decision took its BCL half away, which the ninth correction above records. A fifteenth time, in the two il-only elements only: the XACT engine cluster built Audio.AudioEngine and Audio.AudioCategory, and AudioEngine was Audio.Cue's one il-only unmet dependency, so Cue left the il-only blocked list -- 9 to 8 -- and its signature-complete subset -- 3 to 2. dependencyCompleteCandidates is unchanged at 8 because AudioCategory left as WaveBank arrived behind AudioEngine, which is the same uncovering DynamicSoundEffectInstance recorded. AudioCategory's own deferral was RUNTIME_DATA reasoning that its members act on a live engine this binding does not have; that is the sixth register entry retired for naming the producer rather than the type, and the first retired because the claim was measured false rather than because the reasoning was re-read. A sixteenth time, in one element only: the XACT banks and the cue were built, so dependencyCompleteCandidates fell 8 to 6 -- Cue and WaveBank left together and nothing arrived behind them, because Audio.SoundBank was the last type either uncovered and it was built in the same milestone. Neither il-only count moved: Cue had already left that list when AudioEngine completed, and WaveBank was never on it. This emptied the Audio namespace off the frontier entirely. A seventeenth time, again in one element only: Media.MediaSource was built and dependencyCompleteCandidates fell 6 to 5. Its deferral was the RUNTIME_DATA register's last entry, and the plainest producer-shaped one of the seven -- GetAvailableMediaSources is ldc.i4.1, newarr, newobj, stelem.ref, ret, so XNA queries no media stack either. The register is empty now, and so is RUNTIME_DATA in the blocker summary. An eighteenth time, in three elements: Graphics.SpriteFont was built, so dependencyCompleteCandidates fell 5 to 4, and because its own il-only dependency SpriteBatch had been complete all along, it left the il-only blocked list too, 8 to 7, and its signature-complete subset 2 to 1. It is the first candidate a BCL decision alone unblocked: System.Char as an Integer code unit, Nullable`1 as nil-or-value and System.Text.StringBuilder as a Ruby String. A nineteenth time, in one element only: Content.ResourceContentManager took dependencyCompleteCandidates 4 to 3, and neither il-only count moved because its IL reaches nothing. It is the first candidate this frontier ever *selected* rather than merely listed -- SELECTION_ROUTE went global-consumable-rank and SELECTED_NEXT named it -- because collapsing System.Resources.ResourceManager to the one member it reaches, GetObject(string), left it with no blocker at all. A twentieth time, and the first time in this direction: Graphics.GraphicsResource and Graphics.Texture2D completed, and dependencyCompleteCandidates **rose** 3 to 9. Six types behind the two just built became visible -- BlendState, DepthStencilState, RasterizerState, SamplerState and VertexDeclaration behind GraphicsResource, and Media.VideoPlayer behind Texture2D. A frontier count rising is what advancing looks like when the types built were bases, and it is the reason this row observes the shape of the frontier rather than only its size. partialDependencySatisfied went 1 to 3 with OcclusionQuery and Texture3D, whose remaining unmet dependencies are the partial GraphicsDevice, and the il-only blocked list fell 7 to 5 while its dependency-complete subset rose 1 to 3 -- VertexDeclaration reaches IVertexType and SamplerState reaches EffectPass, neither of which exists here. Recorded with this correction: the generated report had been **stale** for a whole milestone before this row was re-measured -- it still described SamplerState as waiting on GraphicsResource after GraphicsResource completed -- because analyze_dependencies.rb is not run by the suite. The file's SHA-256 before this correction was ce14510c2adc10750414d03dca0408bdd5eff63d648807791874944aa5e53b72, and test_dependency_frontier.rb now carries a staleness guard so a report agreeing only with itself cannot pass again. A twenty-first time, and back in the usual direction: all four graphics state objects were audited and built, so dependencyCompleteCandidates fell 9 to 6. Every one of the four reported NATIVE_RUNTIME and every one was native-reachable only through `Apply`, which is `assembly`-visible in XNA and is not in the pinned contract -- the ninth deferral this register has retired for naming something the type's public surface never exposes. The fall is 3 rather than 4 because SamplerStateCollection arrived behind SamplerState, the uncovering a completed base always causes. The il-only blocked list fell 5 to 4 and its dependency-complete subset 3 to 2, both because SamplerState left them.
